annotations.title: Estimar costo de tokens de LLM

description:
Estima el costo de llamadas a un LLM a partir de tokens (o texto estimado) y precios por millón indicados; sin lista de precios incorporada. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: estimar el costo de un lote de llamadas pagadas por uso (x402-cost-estimate). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Estimates LLM request cost from input/output token counts (or text, estimated heuristically) and supplied per-million-token prices, with optional cached-input pricing and call volume. No built-in price list. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Estimates LLM request cost from input/output token counts (or text, estimated heuristically) and supplied per-million-token prices, with optional cached-input pricing and call volume. No built-in price list. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: estimating the cost of a batch of pay-per-call API requests (x402-cost-estimate). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

cached_input_tokens.description: Of the input, tokens billed at cache price (integer; optional; default 0; min 0; max 1000000000000).

calls.description: Number of identical calls (integer; optional; default 1; min 1; max 1000000000).

input_text.description: Text to estimate input tokens from (string; optional).

output_tokens.description: Output tokens (integer; optional; default 0; min 0; max 1000000000000).

price_cached_per_mtok.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens (number; optional; default 0; min 0; max 10000).

price_input_per_mtok.description: USD per 1M input tokens (number; required; min 0; max 10000).

price_output_per_mtok.description: USD per 1M output tokens (number; required; min 0; max 10000).
